reason: The image-only reading did not interpret the grid and left the end of the canon uncertain; reread with Clm 3512 in hand and with the grid decoded against computed Easter dates, the canon's key word reads 'annualis/annalis', the example is 1380 with 'e', and the grid is an Easter table beginning in 1353.
sources: Munich, BSB, Clm 3512, fol. 289ra (canon) and the Kalendarium on the following page, MDZ bsb00126931, images 581-582 (page images)

F. S. Pedersen (ed.), Petri Philomenae de Dacia et Petri de S. Audomaro opera quadrivialia, Corpus Philosophorum Danicorum Medii Aevi X (Copenhagen 1983-84), Canon supra kalendarium (Internet Archive search snippets only)
L. Delisle, Bibliothèque de l'École des chartes 48 (1887), p. 532, incipit with heading 'Canon supra kalendarium magistri Petri de Dacia, dicti Philomena' (OCR text)

Source-assisted reading (research reader), corrected on the native image from the image-only first reading stams4-2026-10-31-image-only after the source (Munich, BSB, Clm 3512, fol. 289ra) was found. Reread on the image: all ten canon lines (at 1.5-2x, contrast-stretched), the centre of the left rota, all nineteen sectors of the right rota, the left columns of the grid, and rows xxij-xxviij of the letter grid. The readings "a(n)nual(is)" (line 5) and "a(n)nal(is)" (line 7) were first proposed by an independent checker and then checked by the research reader on the image. 5  vsq(ue) deorsu(m) i(n) eade(m) linea · (et) l(itte)ra illa d(e) l(itte)ris tabule [illi(us)?] q(ue) p(er)fec(er)it a(n)nos d(omi)ni a(n)nual(is)?
6  er(it) · ¶ Si a(utem) p(re)cise siue i(n)[..]l(ite)r? i(n)ueneris a(n)nos d(omi)ni · [tunc littera ul]ti(m)a linee p(re)ce-
7  de(n)tis v(er)sus sinistra(m) · erit l(itte)ra a(n)nal(is) [a(n)ni?] illius · V(er)bi g(ratia) · Esto q(uod) a(n)ni d(omi)ni
8  sint · m · ccc · lxxx · eos i(n)uenies in capite sec(un)de linee versus sinistra(m)
9  [co(m)putando?] a sinistra · (et) ideo l(itte)ra vltima linee p(ri)me · scilicet · e · p[..]
10 [..] erit l(itte)ra [..] anni [..] · Inuenta itaq(ue)
Notes: line 5 shows "ānual", line 7 "ānal'"; probable, not secure. Line 6: the first word after "precise" is clearly "siue"; the second (written ĩc̃sl'r or similar) may be "integraliter". Line 10 is largely unread.
